admin.missions.confirm_launch.message: Every on-duty officer is told, and every Mission Board shows only {mission} until it is completed or cancelled.
admin.missions.confirm_launch.title: Launch {mission}?
admin.missions.confirm_reload.message: Every mission file is read again. Hand edits of custom files are checked against the guardrails and saved as a new version marked edited in code.
admin.missions.confirm_reload.title: Reload mission files?
admin.missions.disabled_note: Built-in missions are read-only: turn them off in Config.DisabledMissions.
admin.missions.eligible_sub: Open to every department and 2+ officers; never the Weekly Boss.
admin.missions.off_config_hint: Turned off in Config.DisabledMissions (config/config.lua). Read-only here.
admin.missions.subtitle: Every built-in and custom mission, the Mission Builder and Cross-Department Missions.
builder.blockdesc.checkpoint_route: Drive to checkpoints in order, optionally against medal times.
builder.blockdesc.escort: Escort a vehicle along a recorded road route through ambushes.
builder.blockdesc.flee_arrest: Knock on a door or chase scattering suspects, then arrest them.
builder.blockdesc.hostile_waves: Armed hostiles arrive in waves; clear them, arrest the ones who surrender.
builder.blockdesc.interact_points: Officers check points with a progress bar, optionally logging a result.
builder.blockdesc.protect_rescue: Free restrained hostages and bring them to a safe marker.
builder.blockdesc.pursuit: Stop fleeing vehicles, or follow one closely for the duration.
builder.blockdesc.search_area: Find clues to shrink the search circle and arrest the fugitives.
builder.blockdesc.skill_check: Skill checks on devices or placed targets; misses cost time.
builder.blocks.intro: Pick up to {max} objective blocks, in the order officers will do them. Each starts with the defaults from config/blocks.lua.
builder.blocks.none: No objectives yet: add blocks from the list.
builder.blocks.remove_message: {label} and its settings are removed, with the points only it uses and its scaled counts.
builder.blocks.title: Objectives
builder.confirm.archive.message: It leaves the mission pool at once and its file moves to missions/custom/archived/. You can restore it later.
builder.confirm.archive.title: Archive {mission}?
builder.confirm.break_lock.message: {name} is editing {mission}. Their changes since the last autosave are lost.
builder.confirm.break_lock.title: Break the edit lock?
builder.confirm.delete.message: It was never published, so the whole mission is deleted.
builder.confirm.delete.title: Delete {mission}?
builder.confirm.discard.message: The draft is deleted; the published v{version} stays live.
builder.confirm.discard.title: Discard the draft of {mission}?
builder.confirm.publish.message: Draft v{version} goes live and {file} is written; the previous file is kept as a backup.
builder.confirm.publish.title: Publish {mission}?
builder.confirm.restore.message: Its file moves back to missions/custom/ and v{version} joins the pool again.
builder.confirm.restore.title: Restore {mission}?
builder.confirm.rollback.message: The previous version (v{previous}) is restored from its .bak file and published as a new version. v{version} is kept as a backup.
builder.confirm.rollback.title: Roll back {mission}?
builder.cp.medals_desc: Gold, Silver and Bronze in seconds; they replace the common fast bonus. Default: {def}.
builder.cp.medals_order: Gold must be at most Silver, and Silver at most Bronze.
builder.cp.points_note: Place {min}–{max} checkpoints per location, or record them by driving.
builder.cp.vehicle_required_desc: A checkpoint only counts while the officer is driving a vehicle (any vehicle).
builder.details.available_all: None ticked: every department gets this mission.
builder.details.available_some: Only the ticked departments get this mission.
builder.details.bonuses_sub: From the standard list only. Flat ones at most {points} points, percentage ones at most {pct}% of P.
builder.details.difficulty_hint: Stars scale the points and the base payout (Config.Difficulty).
builder.details.intro: The mission type sets the points and the base payout. Custom missions have no payout field.
builder.details.items_hint: Count {min}–{max}. Armour, bandages, ammo and weapons can't be mission items.
builder.details.items_sub: Optional ox_inventory items given at the start and removed at the end (at most {max}).
builder.details.name: Name
builder.details.no_payout: There is no payout field: a custom mission pays its type's payout × its star multiplier until an admin sets a mission payout.
builder.details.required_tier: Publishing needs a passed test at
builder.details.title: Details
builder.details.type_hint: Required: it sets the points and the base payout.
builder.details.vehicle_penalties_desc: Heavy damage to an officer's vehicle costs points.
builder.details.vehicle_suggest: Off is suggested: this mission has a pursuit or escort block or armed NPCs ({armed}).
builder.drive.approach_toast: Drive to the start of the route: a GPS waypoint is set.
builder.drive.wrecked: The test vehicle can't drive on: the rest of the route is marked for re-recording.
builder.dup.description: Built-in missions are read-only; the copy is an editable draft. Values outside the builder ranges are listed to fix.
builder.dup.title: Copy a built-in mission
builder.editor.armed_hint: Armed NPCs before scaling, across every block. The limit is {max}.
builder.editor.saved_errors: Draft saved with {n} problems to fix before publishing.
builder.editor.saved_valid: Draft saved: it passes every guardrail.
builder.esc.ambush_note: Place {min}–{max} ambush points per location (default {def}), on the route and at least {gap} m apart.
builder.esc.route_note: Record the route in the Locations step. Press E while recording to add up to {max} stop points; the truck waits {min}–{maxWait} s at each (default {def} s), and that wait never counts toward the stopped timer.
builder.fa.gives_up_close: A participant stays within {d} m for {s} s
builder.fa.mode_door_hint: Officers knock on a door; the suspect surrenders, flees or fights.
builder.fa.mode_scatter_hint: Several suspects scatter along flee paths.
builder.hw.boss_desc: One armed boss that never scales (counts as one armed NPC).
builder.hw.boss_spawn: Own spawn point for the boss (otherwise a hostile spawn point)
builder.hw.next_alive: Next wave at this many alive or fewer
builder.hw.per_wave_range: Hostiles per wave {min}–{max}, default {def}. Every armed NPC counts toward the mission's armed budget.
builder.hw.spawn_need: Needs {n} spawn points per location ({per} × the largest wave)
builder.ip.label: Progress label
builder.ip.log: Log a result at each point
builder.ip.log_desc: Officers pick one of 2–4 choices; the server rolls the correct one.
builder.ip.log_note: A correct log can earn the correct-log bonus and a wrong one the wrong-log penalty: add them in Details.
builder.list.duplicated: An editable copy of {mission} was created.
builder.list.empty_text: Build one from scratch or copy a built-in mission.
builder.list.lock_broken: The edit lock of {mission} was broken.
builder.list.rolled_back: {mission} rolled back: v{from} is live again as v{version}.
builder.loc.clear_message: Every {label} point of location {location} is removed.
builder.loc.intro: At least {min} locations, their starts at least {gap} m apart. Spawn points stay at least {spawn} m from the start. Place in world closes the tablet: aim, E places, scroll rotates, Backspace undoes, Enter comes back here.
builder.loc.name: Location name
builder.loc.no_points: The objectives need no points besides the start.
builder.loc.none_text: A mission needs at least {min} locations.
builder.loc.paths_hint: Each flee path is placed point by point.
builder.loc.remove_message: {label} and every point placed there are removed.
builder.loc.route_hint: Recorded by driving and saved as road waypoints.
builder.loc.start_first: Place the start first: spawn points are checked against it.
builder.loc.start_hint: Place where officers arrive for location {location}.
builder.loc.start_radius_search: Follows the search circle of objective {n}: {radius} m (set there, {min}–{max} m)
builder.loc.tag_loop: a loop ending within {m} m of its start
builder.loc.tag_spawn: at least {m} m from the start
builder.loc.title: Locations
builder.lock.archived: Archived missions are read-only. Restore it from the list to edit it again.
builder.lock.builtin: Built-in missions are read-only. Duplicate it to make an editable copy.
builder.lock.lost: {name} broke your edit lock. Changes since the last autosave are lost; the mission is read-only.
builder.lock.mine: You hold the edit lock · {time} left, renewed on every save
builder.lock.none: You don't hold the edit lock, so this mission is read-only.
builder.lock.other: {name} is editing this mission · lock ends in {time}
builder.lock.permission: You can view this mission; only its owner or someone allowed to edit any mission can change it.
builder.new.description: Pick its type first. You then choose up to {max} objective blocks.
builder.new.name_hint: Optional, up to {max} characters: you can change it later.
builder.new.title: New mission
builder.not_allowed: Not in the allowed list: remove it
builder.ov.heading: {deg}°
builder.ov.wait_approach: Drive to the route start ({m} m): a GPS waypoint is set
builder.ov.wait_checking: Checking the road paths between waypoints…
builder.ov.wait_clear: Move away from the route start
builder.ov.wait_return: Drive back to the end of the recording ({m} m)
builder.ov.wait_vehicle: Get in a vehicle as the driver to record
builder.pick_hint: Pick at least {min} from the allowed list
builder.place.reason.blocked: Inside a wall, object or vehicle
builder.place.reason.gap: Closer than {min} m to another location's start
builder.place.reason.spacing: Closer than {min} m to another point
builder.place.reason.start: Closer than {min} m to the start
builder.place.reason.steep: Too steep: not on the ground
builder.pr.fail_if_dies_desc: A hostage death fails the mission for everyone.
builder.pr.points_note: Place at least one spot per NPC and a safe marker in every location.
builder.pr.restrained_desc: Hands tied until an officer cuts the restraints.
builder.presence.checkpoint_route: from the next checkpoint or the nearest partner
builder.presence.flee_arrest: from the nearest suspect not yet cuffed
builder.presence.interact_points: from the nearest point not yet done
builder.presence.protect_rescue: from the nearest NPC being protected
builder.presence.pursuit: from the nearest suspect vehicle or suspect on foot
builder.presence.search_area: margin outside the current search circle
builder.presence.skill_check: from the device or point being worked on
builder.pub.check_draft: There is a draft to publish
builder.pub.check_no_lock: You don't hold the edit lock
builder.pub.check_no_permission: You may not publish this mission
builder.pub.check_tested: Passed a test at {tier} or higher
builder.pub.done_text: It joined its type's pool for the chosen departments, and its Lua file was written.

builder.rec.stop_here: There is already a stop point here

builder.rec.stops_off: Stop points are only for escort routes

builder.tool_stopped_run: The Mission Builder tool stopped because a mission started for you. Nothing was changed.

builder.fc.probable_cause: Probable cause needed for a vehicle search
